reason: It's free and it kills my 2am app-switching between the reader and the group chat — if the reader is decent on my phone, taking the invite costs me nothing.
objection: Discord plus a shared folder already works fine, and if the rest of the group doesn't actually move over, the site is just one more empty room I have to check.
would_change_my_mind: If the group chat doesn't come with me and I'm the only one still reading there, I'm back to Discord within a week.
